bounds.knownId: launch wait <= launchTimeoutMs, then confirmation <= completionTimeoutMs; failure cleanup may wait at most cancelTimeoutMs before releasing URL
bounds.unknownLaunch: launch deadline releases URL; eventual valid late id is observed and best-effort cancelled with bounded acknowledgement; unknown launch cannot be guaranteed cancelled
bounds.poll: one search at a time, independent search deadline, no further search after settled; Chrome search promises cannot be physically aborted
bounds.warning: All bounds are timer scheduling bounds while JavaScript runs, not wall-clock guarantees during browser suspension, nor Blob generation/recording SLOs

behavior.urlLifetime: normal success waits for complete; known-id failure attempts cancellation and waits bounded acknowledgement before revoke; unknown launch releases at timeout and reports final state unknown
behavior.failureMessage: 下载最终状态未知，请检查浏览器下载列表后重试；取消不代表文件已删除
